description: Presidential Secretariat - Declaring that the provisions of the Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act, No. 13 of 2005 shall come into operation in Western, North Western, Sabaragamuwa, North Central, Central and Uva Provinces on 30.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is a proclamation by the President declaring that the provisions of the Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act, No. 13 of 2005 shall come into operation in specified provinces due to a state of disaster. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action involving the activation of existing legislation, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
